analysis_after_lock: Compare each candidate separately against both observed interval references and their disagreement, in px and local staff-interline units. Report signed errors and interval coverage for all repairs and fixed controls, visible/unknown counts, and failures without dropping hard cases. Staff geometry, physical source head/pivot, semantic pitch placement and future replacement-glyph anchor are distinct claims. Report sensitivity to line uncertainty; no pass threshold is defined here and no acceptance rule is changed.
annotation_instructions: In each unchanged source crop, locate the notehead body closest to the horizontal center of the crop without assuming its pitch. Mark independently observed middle and bottom staff line polylines across the visible crop; mark the physical head-body bounds and plausible pivot x/y interval; mark every visible ledger centerline associated with that head and its y interval. Record uncertainty intervals and reasons for blur/overlap/stem/ledger ambiguity. Unknown and occluded features remain null with a reason; never infer an invisible ledger or snap head/pivot to a staff grid. Distinguish physical body judgment from any proposed glyph-placement anchor. If multiple central heads cannot be distinguished, mark unresolved. Do not edit crop pixels. Physical pivot range means the plausible geometric center of the oval head body judged from its visible outline, excluding attached stem and ledger strokes where distinguishable; it is an observed body-center range, not a persisted software pivot or a future glyph anchor. If that separation is not supported by pixels, leave the range unknown. Supply uncertainty intervals for the line observations as well as the body and ledger. Clipped features remain unknown with a clipping reason; do not select a different head to make the case measurable.
annotators: Two independent humans competent to read staff notation; neither involved in correction, candidate implementation or this investigation. Separate sessions, no discussion before both signed exports are locked. Do not send them this protocol's selection field; coordinator provides only annotation_instructions, coordinate_convention, reference_fields and source-only cases.
blinding: Annotators receive only blind-packet directory. Hide repair status, semantic IDs/pitches, expected y, old-plan targets, guards, derived coordinates and hidden-solution-key. Neither annotator sees the other labels or the hypothesis. Do not describe the sample mixture or selection rule until labels are locked.
coordinate_convention: Native source raster, x right and y down. Report page coordinates in the pixel-index-center frame: first pixel sample center is (0,0); a pixel at index (i,j) has geometric edges i±0.5,j±0.5. Crop integer array-index bounds are half-open. If viewer pointer coordinates have origin at the outer top-left pixel edge, the first sample center is (0.5,0.5), so page_index_center=local_pointer_edge−0.5+crop_origin. If viewer already reports pixel-index centers, page_index_center=local_index_center+crop_origin. Record the viewer convention and conversion before marking; use native resolution without resampling and do not apply posthoc ±0.5 adjustments. Body bounds and line/pivot intervals are continuous coordinates in that declared center frame. Persisted Audiveris bbox metadata is retained separately as left,top,left+width,top+height with bbox center left+width/2,top+height/2; it is not silently normalized to this annotation frame.
independence_limits: No independent labels currently exist. Algebraic replay, persisted OMR glyph bounds/centroids and agreement with the candidate staff formula are diagnostic evidence only. A two-annotator jayu sample cannot establish generalization; a later preregistered held-out score set and independent labels are required before broader acceptance. Future glyph placement requires that glyph's explicit anchor contract and independent source/render correspondence evidence. Case targeting is detector-conditioned through horizontal crop centering and source-only crop context; blinding removes candidate y labels, not this sampling dependency. Preserve unresolved central-head identity rather than guessing.
locking: Coordinator verifies source/crop/protocol hashes and coordinate transform, archives each separate signed label export with SHA256 before revealing candidates. Independent second-pass adjudication uses only source and the two locked labels; preserve both originals and unresolved disagreements. No candidate-based relabeling.
selection: All five historical ledger repairs plus five MATCHED nonrepair controls ranked by SHA256(anchor-reference-v1:semantic_id), excluding repairs; combine and rank by the same hash. No coordinate errors or target outcomes enter selection. MATCHED means status MATCHED in the unchanged existing V4 plan; controls are not claimed to match engraving difficulty or morphology.
